## 3. Sprint 15 Delivered Breakdown (Commit `94a05f0`)

- **Level-3 Microstructure & Order Book Engines (`src/lib/microstructureEngine.ts`, `src/lib/orderBookL3Engine.ts`, `src/types/microstructure.ts`):** 
  - Price-time priority (FIFO) Level-3 Order-by-Order (OBO) queue tracker computing queue-ahead volume ($V_{\text{ahead}} = \sum_{j < i} Q_j$).
  - Algorithmic Iceberg Order Detection: Monitors cumulative volume executed at price rungs and triggers iceberg detection when $\sum \text{VolumeExecuted} > 3 \times \text{PeakVisibleSize}$.
  - Volume-Weighted Micro-Price calculation adjusting for bid-ask imbalance ($P_{\text{micro}} = \frac{Q_b P_a + Q_a P_b}{Q_b + Q_a}$).
  - Volume-Synchronized Probability of Toxicity (VPIN) bounded metric ($0 \le \text{VPIN} \le 1$).
  - SEBI institutional block/bulk deal tracker simulating off-market block transactions ($> ₹5\text{ Crore}$ or $> 0.5\%$ equity float) with premium/discount spread analysis.
- **Interactive UI Modals:**
  - `MicrostructureModal.tsx`: Visualized L3 depth order ladder, live iceberg order stream, institutional block tape, and estimated queue wait time indicator.
- **State & Terminal Synchronization:** "🌊 L3 & Dark Pool" navigation button in `Header.tsx`, Landing Page feature card, and terminal execution hooks.
- **Test Coverage:** Added 10 new automated tests across `microstructureEngine.test.mjs` and `orderBookL3Engine.test.mjs`, expanding test suite to 78 total passing assertions.

## 4. Sprint 16 Task Progression: Statistical Arbitrage & Cointegration Pairs Trading Engine

### 4.1 Vision & Scope
Sprint 16 introduces institutional-grade statistical arbitrage on correlated Indian equity and index pairs:
1. **Cointegration Regression & Stationarity:** Engle-Granger 2-step cointegration, Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) unit root test ($t_{\text{stat}} < -2.86$), and Johansen trace eigenvalue test.
2. **Dynamic Kalman Filter Hedge Ratio:** Recursive time-varying hedge ratio estimation ($\beta_t$) capturing structural drift between pairs.
3. **Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Mean-Reversion:** Spread half-life ($t_{1/2} = \frac{\ln(2)}{\theta}$) and equilibrium reversion modeling.
4. **Market-Neutral Execution:** 2-leg synthetic execution (Long Asset A, Short Asset B) with Indian statutory tax cost friction guards (`taxEngine.ts`).
